entities.name: José Raúl Delgado
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Raúl Delgado Díez  is a Cuban baseball player and Olympic gold medalist. Delgado is a one time gold medalist for baseball, winning at the 1992 Summer Olympics. He is the uncle of Lourdes Gourriel, and the granduncle of Yulieski Gourriel.
